**In brief**: Simply Wall St estimates that Synopsys (SNPS) may trade about 10% below fair value even after AI-related deals with OpenAI and Amazon.

### Key points
- Synopsys is a leading supplier of electronic design automation (EDA) software and semiconductor design IP.
- The report refers to AI-related deals with OpenAI and Amazon. The headline does not give their scope or value.
- Simply Wall St's valuation model puts the stock roughly 10% below its estimated fair value.
- The figure is a model estimate, not company guidance or a disclosed financial target.

### Why it matters
OpenAI and Amazon are designing their own chips, which makes the companies that sell chip-design tools an indirect way to invest in AI. Still, the "10% undervalued" figure comes from one outlet's model. Investors should check it against other analyses before relying on it.
